title: Crispy Salmon & Asparagus
description: Slow-seared atlantic salmon with grilled fiber-rich greens. Designed to prevent glucose spikes while satisfying gourmet cravings.

steps.title: Prepare the Salmon
steps.description: Pat the 6oz Salmon Fillet dry with a paper towel. Season generously with kosher salt and cracked black pepper on all sides.

steps.title: Sear the Skin
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Place salmon skin-side down. Press firmly for 30 seconds to prevent curling.

steps.title: The Flip
steps.description: Carefully flip the fillet using a fish spatula. Add 1 clove garlic to the pan for basting.

steps.title: Rest & Serve
steps.description: Remove from pan and let it rest for 2 minutes. Drizzle with lemon juice and serve warm alongside grilled asparagus.

title: Berry Chia Power Pot
description: Omega-3 rich pudding with wild blueberries and toasted nuts. A breakfast or snack that supports blood sugar balance and keeps you full.

steps.title: Combine Chia & Yogurt
steps.description: Mix the chia seeds and unsweetened Greek yogurt in a bowl or small glass jar. Stir well to prevent clumping.

steps.title: Chill & Set
steps.description: Cover and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes (or overnight) to allow chia seeds to expand, releasing high-fiber mucilage that slows carb digestion.

steps.title: Toppings
steps.description: Stir the mixture gently. Top with wild blueberries and sliced almonds for a perfect healthy fat crunch.

title: Sprouted Grain Turkey Wrap
description: Slow-digesting sprouted wheat with avocado cream and lean turkey. High protein and packed with fiber for sustained energy.

steps.title: Prep Wrap & Avocado
steps.description: Place the sprouted grain wrap on a clean board. Mash the half avocado directly on the wrap to form a nutrient-dense, healthy-fat barrier.

steps.title: Layer Fillings
steps.description: Layer fresh turkey breast slices over the avocado spread. Add baby spinach and thinly sliced bell peppers.

steps.title: Roll & Slice
steps.description: Roll the wrap tightly, tucking in the sides. Slice diagonally and enjoy immediately for steady blood sugar release.

title: Golden Roasted Steaks
description: Anti-inflammatory turmeric roasted cauliflower steaks served with fresh garden herbs and healthy olive oil.

steps.title: Slice & Brush
steps.description: Brush thick slices of cauliflower (or cauliflower florets) with olive oil and seasoned garlic.

steps.title: Roast
steps.description: Roast at 400°F (200°C) until golden brown and caramelized around the edges. Cauliflower has a low GI and glycemic load.

steps.title: Plate with Greens
steps.description: Serve warm over a bed of baby spinach, adding a squeeze of fresh lemon if desired.

title: Skillet Shakshuka
description: Slow-absorbed carbs with fiber-rich peppers, tomatoes, and poached eggs. Hearty, spicy, and perfectly low-glycemic.

steps.title: Sauté Veggies
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a skillet. Sauté chopped bell peppers and garlic until soft. Add cherry tomatoes and simmer until they break down into a thick sauce.

steps.title: Create Wells
steps.description: Use a spoon to create small wells in the sauce. Crack an egg directly into each well.

steps.title: Poach Eggs
steps.description: Cover the skillet and simmer over low heat until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny. The fats and protein in eggs delay gastric emptying.

title: Flank Steak & Walnut Salad
description: Bitter greens, healthy fats from toasted walnuts, and tender flank steak. A restaurant-quality meal with near-zero blood sugar impact.

steps.title: Sear Steak
steps.description: Sear the flank steak in a hot skillet for 3-4 minutes per side. Let it rest, then slice thinly against the grain.

steps.title: Dress Greens
steps.description: Toss fresh baby spinach with olive oil and fresh lemon juice. Lemon acidity helps blunt the glycemic curve of the entire meal.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Top dressed greens with sliced steak and toasted walnuts for healthy fats and high contrast texture.
